mapper.select: select inst_id, inst_name, to_char(create_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS create_dt, to_char(update_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS update_dt, inst_address, inst_phone, inst_post, inst_head_name, inst_detail_address, del_yn from t1000_institution where del_yn='N' order by create_dt DESC, update_dt DESC
mapper.insert: insert into t1000_institution ( inst_name, create_dt, update_dt, inst_address, inst_phone, inst_post, inst_head_name, inst_detail_address ) values ( #{instName}, SYSDATE, #{updateDt}, #{instAddress}, #{instPhone}, #{instPost}, #{instHeadName}, #{instDetailAddress} )
mapper.update: update t1000_institution set inst_name=#{instName}, update_dt=SYSDATE, inst_address=#{instAddress}, inst_phone=#{instPhone}, inst_post=#{instPost}, inst_head_name=#{instHeadName}, inst_detail_address=#{instDetailAddress}, del_yn=#{delYn} where inst_id=#{instId}
mapper.select: select inst_name from t1000_institution where del_yn = 'N'

SELECT inst_id, inst_name, to_char(create_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS create_dt, to_char(update_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS update_dt, inst_address, inst_detail_address, inst_phone, inst_post, inst_head_name, del_yn FROM t1000_institution i
AND del_yn = #{delYn}
AND inst_name LIKE '%' || #{instName} || '%'
AND inst_head_name LIKE '%' || #{instHeadName} || '%'
AND inst_address LIKE '%' || #{instAddress} || '%'
AND create_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND create_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND update_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND update_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
ORDER BY create_dt DESC, inst_id DESC ORDER BY update_dt DESC, inst_id DESC ORDER BY inst_name
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t1000_institution i
AND i.del_yn = #{delYn}
AND i.inst_name LIKE '%' || #{instName} || '%'
AND i.inst_head_name LIKE '%' || #{instHeadName} || '%'
AND ( i.inst_address LIKE '%' || #{instAddress} || '%' OR i.inst_detail_address LIKE '%' || #{instAddress} || '%' )
AND i.create_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND i.create_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND i.update_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND i.update_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
